description:
Create a link between two highlights to form an insight thread.
Supports both same-document and cross-document linking.

IMPORTANT — parent/child semantics:
- parent_highlight_id = the highlight you are viewing (the "context" highlight)
- child_highlight_id = the highlight you are linking TO (the "related" highlight)
- link_type describes what the CHILD does to the PARENT:
  - supports: "child supports parent" (child provides evidence for parent)
  - contradicts: "child contradicts parent" (child challenges parent)
  - expands: "child expands parent" (child elaborates on parent)
  - questions: "child questions parent" (child raises questions about parent)
  - related: general connection

For cross-document links, set target_document_id to the document containing the
child highlight. If omitted, both highlights are assumed to be in source_document_id.

Example: If highlight A says "GDP grew 5%" and you want to link highlight B
"Exports increased 12%" as supporting evidence, then:
  parent_highlight_id = A (the claim), child_highlight_id = B (the evidence),
  link_type = "supports" (B supports A).

params.description: Parameters for creating a link between two highlights (same-doc or cross-doc).

child_highlight_id.description: The highlight you are linking TO (the 'related' highlight). This highlight performs the action described by link_type on the parent.

link_type.description: Describes what the child does to the parent. 'supports' = child provides evidence for parent. 'contradicts' = child challenges parent. 'expands' = child elaborates on parent. 'questions' = child raises questions about parent. 'related' = general connection.

parent_highlight_id.description: The highlight you are viewing or working on (the 'context' highlight). The link_type describes what the child does TO this highlight.

source_document_id.description: UUID of the source document containing the parent highlight

target_document_id.description: UUID of the target document for cross-document links. If omitted, same-document link.
